text:
Sasha: kicking off change window 17:00-18:00 UTC for v2.3.0 rollout. tagging ops + release leads. please watch the SLO dashboards and call hold if you see >0.5% 5xx or p95 latency jump.

deploy-bot: :rocket: rollout started: v2.3.0 -> canary 10% traffic. track: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/serving/serving-slos

Maria: grabbing dashboard snapshot now, will push to #release-archives. quick check: p95 is 120ms baseline, keep an eye if >180ms.

Jared: seeing a small 502 burst on eu-west-1 at the canary slice, ~15 errors in 2m, spike in the proxy logs. Not yet at 0.5% overall.

Sasha: ok callout. what endpoint?

Jared: /v1/generate mostly; here's the tail of the proxy log:

```
2026-03-21T17:02:13Z proxy[eu-west-1] WARN upstream 502 for req_id=abc123 route=embed-service
2026-03-21T17:02:14Z proxy[eu-west-1] WARN upstream 502 for req_id=abc124 route=embed-service
```

Maria: I'm exporting a 10m window snapshot and CPU/mem for the pods now, will attach. If it correlates with a scaling event we can ignore.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (10%): p95 latency=130ms, 5xx_rate=0.12% (15m), error_budget_used=0.6%

Eva: low priority but flagging that kvcache miss rate increased in the same window — could explain latency.

Chandra: agree with Sasha, hold criteria not met yet. propose to continue to 25% but slow ramp (5% increments with 3m pause) and watch for eu-west anomalies.

Sasha: +1 to slow ramp. Maria, can you snapshot the SLO heatmap and post to this thread?

Maria: done. uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.local/releases/v2.3.0/snapshot-4590012345.png

Jared: after the snapshot, 502s dropped, looks like a transient proxy flurry. No resource OOMs.

Sasha: ok moving forward to 25% via canary policy. deploy-bot, please proceed on slow ramp and notify if 5xx >0.3% or p95 >200ms.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Next bump scheduled in 3m. alerts: will trigger on configured thresholds.

Eva: leaving a quick note for post-mortem checklist: include kvcache miss rate graph, proxy retransmits, and any request-size histograms.

Chandra: ops handoff in 20m to nightshift team. tagging @night-ops for awareness. please review this thread before handoff.

Sasha: final: if any region crosses 0.5% 5xx or p95 >250ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows, we rollback. rollback command (ops):

```
deploy-bot rollback --service embed-service --to-version v2.2.8 --reason "canary SLO breach"
```

Jared: got it. I'm enabling a temporary route pin for eu-west to divert to stable if needed: `routectl pin embed-service eu-west stable`

Maria: leaving the snapshot and a short release note (known transient proxy flurry in eu-west, resolved) in the changelog draft.

Sasha: thanks — continuing to watch. :eyes:
